Sizes.title: Sizes
Sizes.description: A product with no size run of its own is sold in the default run, XS to 3XL. Those codes, and any code a product stocks, cannot be deleted; past orders keep their sizes either way.

remove.description: No product stocks it, and past order lines keep their size as text, so nothing else changes. It can be added again later.

dialog.description: The upcharge is added to every unit in this size, on top of the tier price.

Tiers.title: Price tiers
Tiers.description: An order is priced on its total quantity: the deepest tier it reaches sets the discount off each product's single-unit price, and no unit ever costs less than that product's bulk price. Size upcharges are added on top.
Tiers.capped: The preview offers the first {shown} of {total} products on sale, in shelf order.

ladder.title: Ladder
ladder.description: A tier starts at a total quantity and takes a percentage off every product's single-unit price. The first is always one unit at no discount.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: One unit at each tier, before size upcharges.
preview.ownerHint: Owners set prices. One unit at each tier, before size upcharges.
preview.none: No product on sale to preview with.
preview.invalid: Fix the ladder to see what it would charge.

PriceSync.title: Price edits are switched off
PriceSync.description: The storefront still shows prices from code, while checkout charges what is in the database. Until the storefront reads prices from the API, a price changed here would put one number on the product page and charge another - so prices, size upcharges and the tier ladder are read-only. Copy, colours and archiving still save.
